links.comparator_used: Baseline condition with no middleware, where the agent model's own behavior decided which tool actions executed (N = 50 trials per scenario; Gemini 2.5 Flash, cross-validated with Claude Sonnet 4.6)
links.outcome: Unauthorized-tool execution success, contraindication misses, and policy-injection success in six adversarial red-team scenarios
links.effect: Baseline: unauthorized tools executed in 56–60% of adversarial trials. HAARF deterministic middleware: unauthorized-tool success 0%, contraindication misses 0%, policy-injection success 0% (95% Wilson CI [0.00, 0.07]). Cross-model validation gave identical security metrics.
links.quote: Under the HAARF condition, deterministic middleware enforcement reduces the unauthorized-tool success rate to 0%, with 0% contraindication misses and 0% policy-injection success (95% Wilson CI [0.00, 0.07]).

design_hint: deterministic middleware guardrail enforcement for autonomous clinical agents
